name: Win The Game
source:
As the character Shinobu, put yourself into your very own Battle Royale-inspired murder game.

You will start the game with some food rations and a random weapon. You can get anything from a shoe to a flame thrower.

Try to kill everybody within the set time limit, or find if there's another way off the island.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25603&sid=6e8d3db7b39e94983872d2c4441fb702]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
以忍为角色，把自己投入一场受《大逃杀》启发的杀人游戏。

游戏开始时，你拥有一些食物补给和一件随机武器。武器可能是鞋子，也可能是火焰喷射器。

尝试在规定时间内杀死所有人，或者寻找离开岛屿的其他方法。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25603&sid=6e8d3db7b39e94983872d2c4441fb702]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
